text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on the subject street, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the north side of Springhurst Avenue.

City Council on April 17 and 18, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate an on-street accessible parking space in effect at all times on the north side of Springhurst Avenue, between a point 57 metres west of Dufferin Street and a point 5.5 metres further west.
